name: Albemarle Corp.
summary:
Albemarle (ALB) reported earnings of $2.95 per share on revenue of $1.43 billion for the first quarter ended March 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.24 per share on revenue of $1.33 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.45 per share. The company beat expectations by 103.45% while revenue grew 32.67% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect 2026 revenue of $5.70 billion to $6.00 billion. The current consensus revenue estimate is $5.80 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Albemarle Corp is a developer, manufacturer and marketer of engineered specialty chemicals. It provides its sevices to end markes including petroleum refining, consumer electronics, construction, automotive, lubricants and pharmaceuticals.
subject: Albemarle Beat Expectations
